lines: His waking from yours, his sleep from yours;
Hence everything of your nature: the world, real-and-not.
sanskrit_cite: tvatprabodhāt prabodho'sya tvannidrāto layo'sya yat | atastvadātmakaṃ sarvaṃ viśva sadasadātmakam

lines: Tongue weary of your name, mind weary of your recall.
Formless one — what meditation? Qualityless — what name?
sanskrit_cite: jihvā śrāntā bhavannāmni manaḥ śrāntaṃ bhavatsmṛtau | arūpasya kuto dhyāna nirguṇasya ca nāma kim

lines: For the full, whence the call? For the all-homed, whence a seat?
For the clean, foot-water and honors? For the pure, sipping?
sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasyāvāhanaṃ kutra sarvādhārasya cāsanam | svacchasya pādyamarghyañca śuddhasyācamanaṃ kutaḥ

lines: For the stainless, what bathing? For the world-wombed, what robe?
For the unsmeared, what scent? For the fair, what gem?
sanskrit_cite: nirmalasya kutaḥ snānaṃ vastraṃ viśvodarasya ca | nirlepasya kuto gandho ramyasyābharaṇaṃ kutaḥ

lines: Thread for the propless, blooms for the wishless.
Noseless, take incense; eyeless, take lamp — to what use?
sanskrit_cite: nirālambasyopavītaṃ puṣpaṃ nirvāsanasya ca | aghrāṇasya kuto dhūpaścakṣurhīnasya dīpakaḥ

lines: Food for the ever-full, betel for the Lord — from where?
Circling for the boundless, bowing for the non-twain — from where?
sanskrit_cite: nityatṛptasya naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca kuto vibhoḥ | pradakṣiṇamanantasyā'dvitīyasyaya kuto natiḥ

lines: Whence lamp-waving for the self-lit Lord?
How is song enjoined for the unsayable by Veda?
sanskrit_cite: svayaṃ prakāśamānasya kuto nīrājanaṃ vibhoḥ | vedavācāmavedyasya kutaḥ stotraṃ vidhīyate

lines: How farewell for the full, within and without?
And how burnt-gift for the partless, everywhere?
sanskrit_cite: antarbahiśca pūrṇasya kathamudvāsanaṃ bhavet | bhedahīnasya viśvatra kathaṃ ca havanaṃ bhavet

lines: Fee where for the full? For the ever-content, what libation?
For the ever-content, what drink-offering?
sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasya dakṣiṇā kutra nityatṛptasya tarpaṇam | visarjanaṃ vyāpakasyā'pratyakṣasya kṣamāpaṇam

lines: So indeed: supreme worship, in every state, at all times —
with undivided mind, yoke mind to the Lord as All-Lord.
sanskrit_cite: evameva parā pūjā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā | aikyabuddhayā tu sarveśe mano deve niyojayet
